MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 11
   C. 29
   D. 3

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

3. Solve for x: x + 7 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 10
   C. 11
   D. 7

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 23

5. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 13

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

8. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 64

9. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 1
   C. 13
   D. 7

10. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 18

11. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 10

13. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 14

14. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 72
   C. 1
   D. 73

15. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 36

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
